name: 投稿に付けたタグの表示
prompt: Generate exactly ONE polished isolated UI component, LH03-0115 投稿に付けたタグの表示. Wide 390×54 logical-pixel white canvas, render at 3x with sharp clean Japanese typography. The PRIMARY original is the full Discord screenshot: reproduce only its tag row above the attachment, not the full screen. Preserve its optical relationships. Left at x21 y18, approximately14×21, use a FILLED slate diagonal hanging PRICE TAG shape with a small white circular hole in its upper-left broad shoulder, long point angled down-right. This is NOT an upright pushpin; the secondary mock wrongly substitutes a pin. To its right place one rounded pill x48 y10 width154 height32 radius16. Official direction: WHITE fill, fine neutral outline and barely perceptible small shadow, no mint. The EXACT one-line Japanese label is ロゴとブランド centered, Meiryo REGULAR 12px /16 line-height, tracking0, slate #526173, visually LIGHT regular strokes, never bold or semibold. No other words, no heading, no border around canvas, no device, no source footer, no surrounding screen. Background pure #FFFFFF. Keep compact restrained Apple-style hierarchy and feedback affordance; this is a static raster reference only. The bus reference supplies material/color direction only, never its layout/content. Preserve the Japanese mock's label and spacing, correct the glyph from the primary original.
reviewNotes: 原画像の穴付き斜めタグを復元。日本語はRegular方向、白ピル・Slate配色。ただし指定390×54に対してキャンバスが縦に広く、上下の余白が過大。比率と密度の補正が必要。ラスター目視のみ、書体完全一致・編集可能性・所有者受入は未確認。
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
